apple.name: The Operator
apple.subtitle: Text-First Scripture Study
apple.promotionalText: Work one passage from context to meaning with text evidence, key-word help, COVENANT guidance, saved studies, and a full iPad sermon workspace.
apple.description:
The Operator is a text-first Scripture study workbench for pastors, teachers, small-group leaders, and serious Bible readers. It helps you work one passage from context to meaning, see the evidence behind the reading, test where an interpretation may be reaching too far, and carry the text toward faithful use.

ON IPHONE
Run a Quick Study when you need a reliable answer without opening a full sermon workspace. See the passage's main claim, original setting, textual evidence, key terms, place in the Bible's whole story, guardrails, and why it matters.

ON IPAD
Choose PLAIN for a complete guided COVENANT study or SERMON for a movable preparation desk. Arrange study tiles, work with maps and timelines, consult specialist perspectives, write and export a manuscript, record a rehearsal, and enter Preach Mode from the same passage.

A GOVERNED PROCESS
The eight COVENANT movements keep context, observation, verification, language, theology, application, and teaching in the right order. The Operator shows how a conclusion was reached and where honest uncertainty remains. It asks, 'What does the text mean?'—never, 'What does it mean to you?'

YOUR WORK STAYS WITH YOU
Save studies and notes to your Operator account, sync them across linked devices, restore eligible store purchases, and permanently delete your account in the app. Sermon recordings remain on the device until you share or delete them.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Start with one included study. Optional auto-renewable subscriptions add a monthly allowance of new studies:
• Starter: $30 per month or $300 per year — 40 studies each month
• Standard: $50 per month or $500 per year — 80 studies each month
• Heavy: $150 per month or $1,650 per year — 300 studies each month

Annual plans are billed for the full year while the study allowance resets each month. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm. Subscriptions renew automatically for the same period and price unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of the monthly study allowance does not roll over. Prices are shown in U.S. dollars; your storefront displays the final local price before purchase.

Terms of Use: https://www.base1520.com/operator/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.base1520.com/operator/privacy/

The Operator uses generative systems and can be wrong. It does not replace Scripture, prayer, the local church, a pastor, or responsible study. Check every conclusion against the text and reliable sources.
